description: Setup step: add eyes.check() visual checkpoints to an existing Playwright test file. Edits source, not results.

activeFile.description: Path to the currently active file or folder in the IDE (optional). Used to improve framework detection in Node.js monorepos by finding the nearest package.json relative to the active context.

fileContent.description: Test file content (optional if filePath provided or if IDE provides it)

filePath.description: Path to the test file that will be edited (optional if fileContent provided)

selection.description: Selected code range from IDE (pass if provided to get better context, optional if not provided will process entire file)

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root directory (optional, defaults to current directory). If the workspace root is a Node.js monorepo (contains a package.json with a "workspaces" field), ask the user which package they want to use the tool on, or if they would like to create a new package in the monorepo.

name: eyes_add_checkpoints_to_test
